STEP 6 - Grams: Cut vegetable pieces, bulk density ~0.6 g/ml. 100 ml x 0.6 = 60 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Roasted sweet potato ~90 kcal/100 g (cooked, with some added oil from roasting, roughly 100 kcal/100 g). Using 100 kcal/100 g: 60 g → 60 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 7 small cubes on a side plate is plausible for roughly 60 g. A small side portion of roughly 60 g and 60 kcal is reasonable.
